notes.title: Femdom University Prequel: MASSIVE UPDATE! Version 1.4
notes.content:
Bow down, gamers! 
My latest creation is here, and it's merciless. I've unleashed a devastating new combat system featuring four formidable enemies—your meager skills will be put to the ultimate test. Survive, if you dare.

You will explore my newly territory, "Rich Street." Wander among the NPCs, the elite older women of the federation, who will either dismiss or exploit you.

The darkness deepens with more Genia content, designed to ensnare you further into her web. And the Gym? Transformed under my command. Coach Mila will now break and rebuild you, training you for combat. Prepare to fight, or crumble, against the fearsome Skullgirl enemies who eagerly await to test your mettle.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Major Content Update: v1.1
notes.content:
Biggest feature:
Goodies (LVL2) complete re-work. 
You work while shrunken. Yes. You work while shrunken.

More scenes, including:
April+Mara (more embarrassing if you have diapers on)

Diapers functionality:
Diapers are now more visible and reduce damage during kicks on the groin and during spanking.

Kelly Questline +1 Quest
Sharylin Questliine +1 Quest
Genia Questline +1 Quest
Ms Herlinda: Bad Ending (very violent / brutal)
Teacher-Ambush events (at night)

Bullying:
You will get bullied you when you have low reputation.
Lower Reputation means: More bullying and more consequences from getting bullied!

Overall a lot of bugfixes and improvements!

Enjoy!
